name: @voice-head/a2a-profile-server
description: Internal-contract A2A endpoint + base-profile store for the voice orchestration head (WS2, docs/kg/02-ws2-a2a-profile.md). Exposes agent-card + JSON-RPC (message/send, tasks/get, tasks/cancel, incubate, profiles/*) on 127.0.0.1; public exposure is reverse-proxied by the WS4 gateway. Mirrors the plugin shape of @maestro/host-callback-bridge.
